extracted.name: Beautiful Spring Appetizer Board
extracted.description: This gorgeous appetizer platter is perfect for spring entertaining! Be sure to make the pickled carrots in advance—they need at least 3 days to marinate in the fridge. If you like, you can make the hard boiled eggs and whipped feta up to 3 days ahead of time too.
instruction_lines: Assemble on a platter and serve!
